name: blecent
description: bluetooth/nimble/blecent and its peer bleprph on two boards: blecent scans (passive, its controller's scan events on the advertising channels), finds bleprph advertising the Alert Notification service, initiates (its controller sends the CONNECT_IND, its window offset aimed at the first anchor) and holds the connection as the master, bleprph as the slave, on channel selection algorithm #2. Over it blecent discovers bleprph's services, characteristics and descriptors, reads the Supported New Alert Category, writes the Alert Notification Control Point (bleprph supports no category: an ATT error, as on a board), subscribes to the Unread Alert Status and to the example's characteristic, writes it, receives its notification and reads it back.
